report: Continue the interrupted map-design conversation: restore the unuploaded V11.5 behavior, reconcile the independent racing branches and fix the reported shortcut-entry AI failure. The recovered V11.0 HTML contains routes but not the later physical-AI implementation; missing behavior will be reimplemented and measured in this recovery.

scope.rationale: Cross-branch integration affects gameplay, persistence, runtime adapters and build outputs. Existing core game and exact run identity are retained.
contextIntentionallyOmitted: Previous test counts that cannot be tied to recovered source

steps: Compare V10, wheel, pacing, cosmetics and original-model branch heads.
Inspect career gate behavior for a fresh player who finished outside the top three.
Recover the V11 playtest and compare its route/AI wiring with GitHub source.
observed: Remote unified branch is absent at recovery start.
Existing rewarded gate only bypasses cumulative-star requirements and still requires a previous podium.
V11 route definitions exist in the saved playtest; recovered AI is the older sample-following implementation, so the last collision bug is not yet reproduced in the correct missing implementation.

acceptanceCriteria: All compatible racing source branches are represented in one immutable GitHub source commit; V11 recovered route data matches the saved playtest data.
Default runtime uses the recovered V11 routes, rotary wheel, 30-level bottom rail, original articulated car and persistent rewarded cosmetics.
A verified completed ad can permanently open exactly the adjacent next level after a real loss, without granting stars, times, fuel or a passed result.
Cancelled, failed, timed-out, duplicate and stale ad callbacks cannot unlock any level; failed durable storage cannot report a permanent unlock.
AI drives the real road and selected branch through native physics; entry collision and recovery are measured on the generated V11 routes, without position/standing/finish injection.

Build, lint, typecheck and targeted engineering checks pass; actual browser startup, driving, result/retry and responsive screen behavior are recorded separately from synthetic physics and live-device claims.
